notes.title: Demo Hotfix [v0.7.0.876]
notes.notes:
13Z Demo Hotfix \[v0.7.0.876]
While we’re working on some bigger updates in the background, we’re also chipping away at optimizations and other small QoL fixes.

Tutorial's graphical performance has been further optimized.

Mouse look sensitivity now can be adjusted on a much wider range.

Reduced controller vibration when Perfect Dodge is executed.

Some causes of FPS drop in the Goat fight in tutorial has been fixed.



You can find us on: 

Discord / X (Twitter) / Tiktok / Youtube / Reddit 



Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes [0.7.0.872]
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/0ca78412b7ce56af8b6982e35e43e8e4ae6fdff9.png"]

Hi Zodiac Challengers! Thanks to your sharp eyes, we’ve been able to tackle more performance & memory optimizations, polish combat flow, and add a few community-inspired touches. This update focuses on smoother play, key balance changes, and important bug fixes.

Have you noticed smoother performance and fewer memory issues since the patch? We’d love to hear your experience. :)[hr][/hr]
VERSION 0.7.0.872 (SEP 4, 2025)


All items with * were inspired by the Community. Thank you!

General and QoL Updates
Further optimized memory usage and reduced memory leak scenarios, especially in boss fights \[ongoing effort].*

Added Fairy Peach as a possible reward in combat encounters.*

Further improvements to jump and fall responsiveness.*

Added a background framerate option in graphics settings.*
Balancing Changes*
Sylith’s (Raven) ranged light attack damage slightly reduced

Blightlight’s fireball damage: 50 → 30

Specturn’s mortar damage: 50 → 40, self-explosion: 10 → 70

Coinlets’ tongue lash damage: 50 → 15, bubble damage: 10 → 5

Sporelings’ explosion damage: 1 → 15

Sporebloomer’s self-explosion damage: 10 → 80

Sporebasher’s head bash damage: 50 → 35

Sporeblade’s spin damage: 50 → 30

Sporepuffer’s projectile hitbox adjusted for accuracy

Sporelobber’s bomb damage: 50 → 75

Ember Vanguard’s (Fire Golem) parts now have increased HP

Stone pillar fall damage fixed at 100

Mountain Technique seals bonus damage: 70% → 40%

Heaven base crit damage multiplier: 150% → 200%

Various Thunder upgrades that utilize Bolt had their damage increased up to 100%.
Bug Fixes
Patch notes window now scrolls properly on first visit

Sylith’s hair now shows the correct blue highlights

Sylith’s special Daggerstorm now appears properly in all boss fights*

Sporebasher’s danger indicator now displays as intended

In the Ember Vanguard fight, players will no longer be blasted away unexpectedly

Stronghold at the end of Act 1 Stage 3 now spawns chests correctly

Water Special (Chilling Infusion) now applies the correct bonus damage

Fairy Peaches can now be stacked properly when consumed multiple times in a trial.

Static requirements of Thunder upgrades now correctly reduce with higher levels.



Crafted with Love, 

Mixed Realms Team



You can find us on: 

Discord / X (Twitter) / Tiktok / Youtube / Reddit 



(˶˃ ᵕ ˂˶) We'd like to end this post with another cute illustration by the talented @astralinferno on our Discord.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #01
notes.notes:
Hey Zodiac Challengers, If you’re late to the news... yes, the DEMO is live! It’s packed with improvements from Playtests 1 and 2, plus a sneak peek of Act 2 in the form of a brand-new biome: the vast desert.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/67580e31f806c2e50ae71772fd33b8145ccb5ba6.png"]

It’s only been a week since the demo launched, and you’ve already kept us busy with your sharp eyes and quick reflexes. From bug reports to balance notes (and even a few wild combos we didn’t see coming), you’ve helped us tune the Trials.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5f8111eeb4e86a83ce55e2fcb91d47795fe51974.png"]

Today we’re serving up the first batch of fixes and updates, focused on the most common issues you raised during Week 1. Think of it as a taste test, as the Pig might say, before the main feast. More tweaks and a few surprises are already simmering for the next update. 🙂


Floaty jumps? We hear you loud and clear.
Not something we're proud of but it seems we changed some values in the code by accident, leading to floaty falls from jumps. 
Share with us what you think about this change after trying the new build so we know whether we're on the right path.

notes.title: New Playtest Update: We've just added one of your most requested features!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/189511aeedeb17f250a1395acd9f4c7bee65abf2.png

Hey Challengers! We’ve been hard at work since the playtest launched, digging through all your feedback and ideas to make 13Z even better. Today, we’re rolling out a fresh update with some key improvements—including a highly requested feature that’s sure to make battles more fluid.

Check out our devlog video that highlights everything new: 
[previewyoutube=Er0zStZVurI;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s New in the Update

Camera Lock Now Available
One of the most requested features—camera lock—has been added to the single-player playtest. Aiming and targeting should now feel much more intuitive. Try it out and let us know what you think!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5e3af02d2d2b656ae74258893339ea572edc0a29.gif

Lyra’s Glow-Up
We’ve updated Lyra’s model, adding more expressions to bring out her personality and charm. This is just one of the many visual improvements we’ll continue refining as we move forward.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/b24cd3c7e974659aa0f7ad14d1f44c5f36fdab36.gif

Enhanced VFX and Lighting
Combat visuals have been refreshed with improved VFX, enhancing the game’s overall feedback during battles. Additionally, lighting has been given a boost, with more defined shadows. This is all part of our ongoing work to elevate the game’s visuals, and there’s more to come!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/ad55070cb92cb86d8982c942b2a62af6e2d6403c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/da79c631a299cc70278e8c492fef66474061578a.png

What’s Next?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/fd01b3b849e0f49e9876a7e88d5f34dc1a74541e.png
We’re gearing up for the next big milestone: the co-op playtest with new content! This update will not only let you team up with friends but will also introduce new mechanics and systems, including:

The Trigram Upgrade System:
Inspired by the Trigrams (bagua), upgrades will feature interconnected elements like Heaven, Lake, Fire, Lightning, Wind, Water, Mountain, and Earth. These elements will synergize in unique ways to create deeper strategies depending on how they’re unlocked in the trigram wheel. They will also linked to the Guardians serving as the main bosses in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/0611fcb46d305685866cac64ecde5b2e9abab502.png
For example: Lightning upgrades spread damage by default, but pair it with Fire upgrades, and you can chain debuffs like burn for extra devastation.

Martial Arts System (MAS):
With help from the Monkey Zodiac, you’ll soon be able to swap abilities and customize your builds. This system will work alongside the Trigram mechanics to make every run feel fresh and rewarding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/928b35fc0b80ebe7fc2f45863aef0fe230322ce2.png

We'll cover the details and other upcoming content to watch out for in our future devlogs so stay tuned ;) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/26a24e812fbf1b1af58424c626a4f6a439f1c105.png
We’re so grateful for your support and feedback—it’s been incredible to build this game with you. If you haven’t already, wishlist 13Z on Steam and hop into the latest update to share your thoughts!

Join the discussion on Discord, where you can chat with other Challengers and share your ideas or creations. Fanart, questions, suggestions —bring it on! We’re always excited to see what the community comes up with.

Chat with us on: Discord | Twitter | Tiktok | Youtube

Thank you for being part of this adventure with us. 

Crafted with love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.title: Devlog #03: Playtest Feedback, Sneak-Peeks and the Next Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/34a680eacf42ae2f179b413aa338aa1cd6d7cade.png

Hey Zodiac Challengers!

We've got some fun updates and news for everyone, plus a bit of what’s brewing behind the scenes since the release of the playtest.

What We’re Working On
We’re super grateful (and honestly, a bit relieved! 😌) for the positive reception since the playtest launched. It’s been amazing to see so many of you enjoying the fluidity and verticality of the combat! We’re eager to build upon what you love about the game, and we’d love for you to continue being a part of this journey with us.

With all the insights you shared, we’ve zeroed in on some key areas to improve—and, luckily, they match up perfectly with our plans. Here are a few things we’re focusing on:

Improving Level Design
We’re restructuring some rooms and making overall improvements to the size, layout and verticality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/48351b84830ff22aaf8440a371d406498747910e.png

Pacing
Coins will be rewarded upon the completion of the room rather than being distributed in random vases and pots all over the rooms. These breakable items will still have a chance to contain health drops, though.

Attack Variations & Deeper Progression
We’re working on something new and big, and will reveal the details soon… this deserves its own dedicated devlog. ;) But here's a preview of one of those exciting changes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/a0cc54ee977394188fe83a5418cae3e97858dfc8.gif

Telegraphing
Getting hit from behind? We’re enhancing telegraphing animations and effects to provide clearer cues in the heat of battle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/5df295f4f274cb44eeab3db4d8a333c3571c892c.png

Graphics Upgrades / Explorations
Along with adding more details to the environment, we’re experimenting with shaders to give 13Z a more unique look that matches its theme. It’s still a work in progress but we’d love to hear what you think.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/602a3de291b28411862a147af0c025d94d5b5074.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9aabb0fc92638c4005dd65cb64d7658d27018339.gif

We're also experimenting with water physics to make the environments more immersive. This will compliment Act 1’s various water features like the waterfalls and Gold Croak's level. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/9c90bfec244138f4f8d32ad07aa79a2193914928.gif

Handy QoL Tweaks
Features like camera lock and smoother targeting are on the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/999b223e32c59748d5bb3995aa1a5f26b73777c9.gif

New Key Art Sneak Peek 
We've also heard you asking about more info on the 12 Zodiacs—and we’re on it! We’re working on new key art that gives them a bigger spotlight. It’s super early, and some of the headshots are more playful than serious (our artist was having fun, lol), but we wanted to give the community a better sneak peek into 13Z's universe. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/e3b14754268f9dac0fec3193fb0a4d874309988f.png

About the Next Playtest Update
We’re fully diving into co-op mode development, along with some new mechanics. We’re targeting Q1 2025 for the big Co-op Playtest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/4d9e934702c0c2efa179b9513aec06603dca3e2a.gif

But you don’t need to wait that long to play an updated version of the current single-player playtest. We’ll be releasing another patch soon. However, some of the bigger changes mentioned above won’t make it into this upcoming patch just yet, as the co-op and single-player builds are on different tracks, and transferring all new mechanics would break the game.

We don’t have a specific date for this update yet, but we’re targeting to release it before the end of the year. Here’s what you can expect:

 Camera/Target Lock – Yep, it’s finally on the way!
 Enhanced VFX – A little extra flash never hurts.
 New Visuals for Lyra – We’ve made some tweaks to bring out her character more; we’ll showcase more sneak-peeks on our Discord. 

Community Updates
On Discord, we’ve added some fresh stickers and emojis for you to play with, and we’re cooking up a few more! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/c1c8e0d1406b9041a91953b07c7a81e675f2017a.gif

Also, here’s the very first fanart of Lyra courtesy of the talented Booey! If you've made fanart of 13Z, we’d love to see it—share it on our Discord, and don't forget to tag us on X (@13Z_game) so we don’t miss it. ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006846/6bdc0705bc5ac300da16a5cd77ffe2c34162d62a.jpg

Thanks for being with us and sharing your feedback! We’re excited to be building 13Z together with you!

Chat with us on: Discord | Twitter | Tiktok

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms Team

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes: Hotfix 0.5.1.671
notes.notes:
Hey, Zodiac Challengers! Thanks for all your bug reports so far—keep ‘em coming! During the Global Playtest, we’re prioritizing critical bugs and anything that breaks the game. 

Without further ado, here are the fixes in this update:

## [0.5.1.671] - 2024-09-20
### Fixed
- Fixed certain challenger SFX not being properly pegged to SFX volume in options.
- Fixed a bug where saved master volume level was not applied correctly at startup.
- Fixed Mushroom Hunt turn-in description incorrectly pointing to Innkeeper instead of Teahouse Keeper.
- Fixed a control config issue with keyboards with non-QWERTY layout.
- Fixes for some UI not appearing correctly in ultrawide resolution.
- Fixed a bug where Loot Magnet blessing would not reset upon returning to the hub.
- Fixed some chests being underground in Stage 2.
- Fixed Blessing Shrines incorrectly handling rounding of HP after deducting HP cost.

Crafted with Love,
Mixed Realms
